competences.description: Removes all harmful effects on yourself and comes back to life with 100% HP and in a condition where you can use all other skills except [Reincarnate]. Additionally, you gain 50% increased Attack Power and Defense every time you use [Reincarnate] (accumulates up to 5 times). You instantly gain another turn after using the skill.
